title: Click by Hint is unavailable without preview features, Cmd-J F runs it with them, and it is unavailable again after the setting is removed (cx-zjtn.1)
preconditions: private scratch config with no labs.previewFeatures key (its default is false)
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with the keyboard

steps.note: off by default: the action is bound and refuses with the preview reason (HintHandlers); on 9b0caf7793d (the parent of cbbbc4642d8, which added it) there is no such action

expect.noReceiptReason: a settings write answers with the applied value; it runs no action

steps.note: the bundle's cmux on the app's socket, as the script's settings.set
Cmd-J arms the leader and F runs hints.show (LeaderLayer.defaultChords): the second key's reply names the action, so the receipt check holds only when it ran

expect.noReceiptReason: Escape ends hint mode inside the hint layer; no registry action runs

steps.note: hint mode ends without clicking anything

expect.noReceiptReason: a settings write answers with the applied value; it runs no action

steps.note: puts the scratch config back, so a later case of the same launch starts with the default
the action follows the setting back to off

invariants: hints.show is unavailable exactly while labs.previewFeatures is not true
Cmd-J F runs hints.show once preview features are on
after Escape the focused workspace and pane equal the launch's: hint mode clicks nothing
the settings facet at ended equals the launch's (the case leaves no setting behind)
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the labels themselves (at least 5, unique, prefix-free, 1-2 letters) and that Escape ends hint mode: no snapshot facet reads debug.hints; a hints facet in snapshot-v1 converts them
typing a sidebar row's label switches to that workspace: the label is known only from debug.hints
Cmd-J F with preview features off: the refused leader run reports no action, which a key step's expect cannot tell from a key nothing handled
